name: Summon Spirit Axos
source: The Summon Spirit of Emilia Anomla. Formerly a Scythe (church-sanctioned Assassin of Necromancers/Liches and their enablers) in their life. Raised as a Nosferatu, a Companion/Summon, and was bound to Emilia Anomla to serve as her Servant.
